Contact & code reports

Found a broken code, an incorrect reward or a changed menu? Give us the evidence needed to check it.

Report through GitHub

Open a code report. You will need a GitHub account. Reports and attachments are publicly visible.

  • The exact code and the page where you found the problem.
  • The exact game response, your test date and device type.
  • Whether you had already redeemed it.
  • A public announcement URL if you are reporting a new code or an expiry.

For a site correction unrelated to a code, open a general issue. Never include passwords, two-factor codes, recovery information or payment details. We cannot recover Roblox accounts or issue rewards.

Email availability

The proposed address contact@hussvalleyhub.org is not configured or verified for delivery. Do not send mail there yet. Use the public reporting route above until this notice changes.

Before you report

Check the redemption steps, the troubleshooting guide and the expiry archive. A source-review date does not mean a code was tested successfully.
